newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin up nine cents to 14.40 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin up nine cents to 14.40 ringgit.

text.p: Malaysia's tin market took its cue from higher overnight prices in London, rising nine cents to 14.40 ringgit ($5.80) a kg after reopening from a near week-long break, traders said.
"The LME (London Metal Exchange) went up $60 when we were closed and the (domestic) market played catch-up today," said a trader.

Final turnover was 104 tonnes compared to 112 on February 5. Buyers were Europeans, Japanese and locals. The local price was at a premium of $45 against London, compared to $50 previously. -- K.Baranee Krishnan (603-2307509) ($1=2.4860)
